properties.name: Little Round Top west slope, summit ridge and Vincent Spur (Hanaway tract)

sources.cite: National Park Service, Gettysburg NMP, "Little Round Top Cultural Landscape Report, Treatment and Management Plan" (2012)
sources.quote_or_paraphrase: The Hanaway tract on the west slope was mostly cleared of trees before 1863; a tree line at the summit separated it from the wooded east-slope tracts; the western face is managed as old field.

sources.cite: Warren, G. K. (survey 1868-69, revised 1873 by P. M. Blake), "Battle field of Gettysburg", scale 1:12,000 (reduced from 1:2,400 original, NARA RG 77 E81). Library of Congress Geography and Map Division, call no. G3824.G3 187- W3 (LC Civil War Maps 353.5), image cw0353500, 8878 x 9845 px JPEG2000
sources.quote_or_paraphrase: Few tree symbols and dense contour hachures on this slope.

properties.method: Hand outline from the CLR site-history text and the Warren sheet.
properties.notes: Cleared does not mean bare: grass or scrub and loose rock with scattered trees; the CLR notes more mature old-field vegetation today than in 1863.
